name: OMRON Corporation
summary: OMRON Corporation engages in industrial automation, device and module solutions, data solutions, social systems, and healthcare businesses in Japan and internationally. The company operates through industrial automation, healthcare, social systems, device and module solutions, and data solution. It provides sensors, switches, safety and control components, relays, motion and drives, robotics, energy conservation, power supplies, and automation system products. The company also offers environmental mobility, digital devices, food and daily necessities, logistics and warehouse automation, medical, robotic, panel, vision, software, and traceability solutions.
